<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xQ_25ZEEVIB0qi9pHuL-"> <mxGraphModel dx="1229" dy="627" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="850" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor Employee
 participant UI as Web/Mobile Client
 participant API as Booking Service
 participant DB as Database
 participant Notif as Notification Engine

 Employee->>UI: Select Desk & Time Slot
 UI->>API: POST /api/v1/bookings
 activate API
 
 API->>DB: Begin Transaction & Lock Desk Row
 activate DB
 DB-->>API: Row Locked
 
 API->>DB: Check Availability
 alt Desk Already Booked
 DB-->>API: Conflict (Slot Taken)
 API-->>UI: 409 Conflict Error
 UI-->>Employee: Display \"Desk Unavailable\"
 else Desk Free
 API->>DB: Insert Booking Record (Status: CONFIRMED)
 API->>DB: Commit Transaction
 deactivate DB
 
 API->>Notif: Trigger Async Email Pass
 Notif-->>Employee: Send QR Code Confirmation
 
 API-->>UI: 201 Created (Booking Details)
 deactivate API
 UI-->>Employee: Show Confirmation Screen
 end",
 "config": null
